text: Hey, quick question—what’s the process for getting internal support logged in Salesforce? I need to loop in the analytics team on an opp but I’m not sure where to start.

Hey Sara! You do that right from the account or opp page. There’s a ‘Request Support’ button—should be up top. Click that, pick the team you need (analytics in this case), and then fill out the form that pops up.
Make sure you pick the right request type and fill in all the required fields (the ones with the red stars). You can also upload docs if you have anything relevant. Then just hit submit.

You’ll get a notification with your case number after. If you need to change anything before submitting, there’s a ‘Previous’ button to go back. It’s all in the handbook under the Salesforce workflow section if you want the step-by-step.
Awesome, thanks Tom! That clears it up. I’ll give it a try now.
